title: OpenClaw for Developers: 12 Workflows That Replace Repetitive Dev Work
summary: OpenClaw automates the dev work that eats your mornings: failing tests, PR descriptions, issue triage, changelogs, and 8 more workflows developers run daily.
body_markdown:
Connect OpenClaw to your GitHub repo via the GitHub MCP integration. Write a short instruction: "When a new issue is opened, apply the most accurate label from our label set, find the related file in the codebase, and leave a comment linking to it. If reproduction steps are missing, ask for them."


This fires on the GitHub webhook and handles every new issue automatically. The backlog shrinks by the next morning.
